headline: You started the clean-up, but a stale GTT has already bought a position you did not want, and 3 more can do the same.

points.label: A stale GTT already fired
points.text: After you closed CANBK 124PE, its old buy GTT triggered at 09:46 and bought 6,750 qty again (now a long that hedges nothing, +₹1.4k). ABB 6000PE, APOLLOHOSP 9100CE and BPCL 300PE have the same kind of leftover GTT and will buy fresh longs if they trigger. Delete these three in Kite today, and after every close from now on.

points.label: Clean-up: half done
points.text: Done: AMBER long sold, BPCL spread, CANBK, APOLLOHOSP call and ABB put closed. Still open: DIVISLAB, HDFCBANK, HINDPETRO and MAHABANK stopped-out spreads (about −₹94k net), the flipped calls, and PFC. The MAHABANK buy-back order at ₹7.3 is sitting unfilled in the book. Monday 23 Nov is expiry day: close all four spreads before then.

points.label: New trades without protection
points.text: 10 new Dec short options were opened today (HAL, MANAPPURAM, PAGEIND, SYRMA calls, and the ICICILIFE, INDUSTOWER, NMDC, RBLBANK, VMM, WAAREEENER spreads). None has a protective GTT yet. Given the stale-GTT lesson, place them with the skill and check each one afterwards.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: Shares: +₹8.9k combined, 20 of 36 in profit, no drawdown so far, against −21.3% tested and PF 1.75. Five weeks and 2 closed trades cannot test any of it. Watch profit factor and average winner after 30 closed trades.

points.label: Market and shares
points.text: 84% of F&O stocks are green and no entry signal exists today. The one add-on (RVNL) filled at ₹188. The shares are healthy, so the whole risk this week is in the options book (open stock-option P&L about −₹72k).

points.label: Advice follow-up
points.text: Yesterday's advice to close the spreads and flipped calls is partly followed. Same advice stands for the rest. One new rule worth keeping: after closing any short, delete its GTT in the same sitting.

action: Delete the 3 stale GTTs now, close the 4 stopped-out spreads before Monday, then place protective GTTs on the 10 new shorts.
